<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-command-docs.ts. Do not edit; run npm run docs:commands. -->

A command is a JSON object with a `type`. You send commands to `execute` or `preview` on a chart, a widget or a headless `ChartRuntime`. See [Drive the chart](../../agents/drive-the-chart/) for the loop, revisions and batches.

This page lists all 24 command types. It is generated from `chartCommandSchema`, the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) exported by `candleframe/core`. The schema checks shapes. The runtime also checks rules that depend on the chart's state, such as whether an id exists or whether a time range is 3 to 2,200 bars wide.

Each example uses only the required properties, plus one optional property where the required ones alone would do nothing useful. The generator sends every example to a headless chart and fails if the runtime rejects it. Examples that name an existing drawing, indicator or group say so.

`history.undo`, `history.redo` and `feed.pause` cannot go in a batch. Send each one on its own.

## `layer.set`

Show or hide a layer.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | one of `"candles"`, `"volume"`, `"indicator"` | yes |  |
| `visible` | boolean | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "layer.set",
  "layer": "volume",
  "visible": true
}
```

## `viewport.set`

Show a time range, 3 to 2,200 bars wide. Stops following live data.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fromMs` | number | yes |  |
| `toMs` | number | yes |  |
| `priceScale` | { mode: `"auto"`; log?: boolean }, or { mode: `"manual"`; minPrice: number, above 0; maxPrice: number, above 0; log?: boolean } | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "viewport.set",
  "fromMs": 1767610800000,
  "toMs": 1767621600000
}
```

## `viewport.reset`

Return to the live view of the latest 180 bars.

No properties besides `type`.

```json
{
  "type": "viewport.reset"
}
```

## `priceScale.set`

Fix the price range. Keeps the log setting.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minPrice` | number, above 0 | yes |  |
| `maxPrice` | number, above 0 | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "priceScale.set",
  "minPrice": 60000,
  "maxPrice": 70000
}
```

## `priceScale.reset`

Fit the price range to the visible candles.

No properties besides `type`.

```json
{
  "type": "priceScale.reset"
}
```

## `priceScale.log`

Switch between log and linear price axes. Refits the range.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "priceScale.log",
  "enabled": true
}
```

## `chartType.set`

Choose how bars draw. heikin-ashi also changes the bar values that autoscale, hover and indicators read. Footprint settings merge with the current ones.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chartType` | one of `"candles"`, `"hollow-candles"`, `"heikin-ashi"`, `"ohlc-bars"`, `"hlc-bars"`, `"high-low"`, `"columns"`, `"line"`, `"line-markers"`, `"step-line"`, `"area"`, `"baseline"`, `"footprint"` | yes |  |
| `footprint` | object | no |  |
| `footprint.mode` | one of `"bidAsk"`, `"delta"`, `"volume"` | no | Cells show sell × buy volume, buy minus sell, or a volume bar. |
| `footprint.imbalance` | boolean | no | Highlight 3:1 diagonal imbalances. |
| `footprint.poc` | boolean | no | Outline each bar's heaviest row. |
| `footprint.summary` | boolean | no | Show delta and volume under each bar. |

```json
{
  "type": "chartType.set",
  "chartType": "heikin-ashi"
}
```

## `indicator.add`

Add an indicator by kind. The id is generated when omitted and returned in `created`.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `indicator` | object | yes |  |
| `indicator.id` | string, matching `^[\w.:-]{1,64}$` | no |  |
| `indicator.kind` | string, not empty | yes |  |
| `indicator.inputs` | object of number values | no | Numeric inputs; see inspect().indicatorKinds for names, defaults and limits. |

```json
{
  "type": "indicator.add",
  "indicator": {
    "kind": "rsi"
  }
}
```

## `indicator.update`

Change some inputs (merged with the current ones) or visibility.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `inputs` | object of number values | no | Numeric inputs; see inspect().indicatorKinds for names, defaults and limits. |
| `visible` | boolean | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "indicator.update",
  "id": "rsi"
}
```

This example needs an indicator with id `rsi` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `INDICATOR_NOT_FOUND`.

## `indicator.remove`

Remove an indicator.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "indicator.remove",
  "id": "rsi"
}
```

This example needs an indicator with id `rsi` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `INDICATOR_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.add`

Add a drawing. See inspect().capabilities.drawingTools for types and point counts.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `drawing` | object | yes |  |
| `drawing.id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `drawing.type` | string, matching `^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{0,79}$` | yes |  |
| `drawing.points` | array of objects, 1 to 1024 items | yes |  |
| `drawing.points[].timeMs` | number | yes |  |
| `drawing.points[].price` | number, above 0 | yes |  |
| `drawing.style` | object | no |  |
| `drawing.style.color` | string, matching `^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,4}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$` | no |  |
| `drawing.style.width` | number, 1 to 8 | no |  |
| `drawing.style.lineStyle` | one of `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"` | no |  |
| `drawing.style.fillOpacity` | number, 0 to 1 | no |  |
| `drawing.style.fontSize` | number, 10 to 32 | no |  |
| `drawing.locked` | boolean | no |  |
| `drawing.visible` | boolean | no |  |
| `drawing.text` | string, at most 2000 characters | no |  |
| `drawing.levels` | array of (number, -1000 to 1000), at most 24 items | no |  |
| `drawing.levelStyles` | array of objects or null, at most 24 items | no | Colour and visibility for levels[i], by index. {} keeps a level at its default. |
| `drawing.levelStyles[].color` | string, matching `^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,4}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$` | no |  |
| `drawing.levelStyles[].visible` | boolean | no |  |
| `drawing.options` | object of boolean, number or string values, at most 32 keys | no | Tool settings; see drawingTools[].settings for keys and defaults. |
| `drawing.visibility` | object | no | Intervals the drawing shows on, per family. Omitted families show on every count; counts are whole numbers in each family's bounds. |
| `drawing.visibility.ticks` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 999999; to?: integer, 1 to 999999 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.seconds` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 59; to?: integer, 1 to 59 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.minutes` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 59; to?: integer, 1 to 59 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.hours` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 24; to?: integer, 1 to 24 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.days` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 366; to?: integer, 1 to 366 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.weeks` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 52; to?: integer, 1 to 52 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.months` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 12; to?: integer, 1 to 12 } | no |  |
| `drawing.visibility.ranges` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 999999; to?: integer, 1 to 999999 } | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.add",
  "drawing": {
    "id": "support",
    "type": "horizontal",
    "points": [
      {
        "timeMs": 1767621600000,
        "price": 64000
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## `drawing.update`

Patch a drawing. Locked drawings reject point changes.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `patch` | object | yes |  |
| `patch.points` | array of objects, 1 to 1024 items | no |  |
| `patch.points[].timeMs` | number | yes |  |
| `patch.points[].price` | number, above 0 | yes |  |
| `patch.style` | object | no |  |
| `patch.style.color` | string, matching `^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,4}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$` | no |  |
| `patch.style.width` | number, 1 to 8 | no |  |
| `patch.style.lineStyle` | one of `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"` | no |  |
| `patch.style.fillOpacity` | number, 0 to 1 | no |  |
| `patch.style.fontSize` | number, 10 to 32 | no |  |
| `patch.locked` | boolean | no |  |
| `patch.visible` | boolean | no |  |
| `patch.text` | string, at most 2000 characters | no |  |
| `patch.levels` | array of (number, -1000 to 1000), at most 24 items | no |  |
| `patch.levelStyles` | array of objects or null, at most 24 items | no | Colour and visibility for levels[i], by index. {} keeps a level at its default. |
| `patch.levelStyles[].color` | string, matching `^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,4}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$` | no |  |
| `patch.levelStyles[].visible` | boolean | no |  |
| `patch.options` | object of boolean, number or string values, at most 32 keys | no | Tool settings; see drawingTools[].settings for keys and defaults. |
| `patch.visibility` | object, or null | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.ticks` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 999999; to?: integer, 1 to 999999 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.seconds` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 59; to?: integer, 1 to 59 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.minutes` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 59; to?: integer, 1 to 59 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.hours` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 24; to?: integer, 1 to 24 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.days` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 366; to?: integer, 1 to 366 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.weeks` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 52; to?: integer, 1 to 52 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.months` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 12; to?: integer, 1 to 12 } | no |  |
| `patch.visibility.ranges` | { enabled?: boolean; from?: integer, 1 to 999999; to?: integer, 1 to 999999 } | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.update",
  "id": "support",
  "patch": {
    "text": "Weekly support"
  }
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.remove`

Delete a drawing.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.remove",
  "id": "support"
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.duplicate`

Copy a drawing under a new id, shifted by `offset` (default three bars right).

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `newId` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `offset` | object | no |  |
| `offset.timeMs` | number | yes |  |
| `offset.price` | number | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.duplicate",
  "id": "support",
  "newId": "support-copy"
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.order`

Move a drawing to the front or back.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `where` | one of `"front"`, `"back"` | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.order",
  "id": "support",
  "where": "front"
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.lockAll`

Lock or unlock every drawing.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locked` | boolean | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.lockAll",
  "locked": true
}
```

## `drawing.clear`

Delete every drawing.

No properties besides `type`.

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.clear"
}
```

## `drawing.reorder`

Set the stacking order. List every drawing id once, back to front.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | array of (string, 1 to 128 characters), at most 100 items | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.reorder",
  "ids": [
    "support"
  ]
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` (and no others) on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `INVALID_DRAWING_ORDER`.

## `drawing.group`

Group drawings under a new id. Members leave other groups and stack next to the frontmost one.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `drawingIds` | array of (string, 1 to 128 characters), 1 to 100 items, unique | yes |  |
| `name` | string, 1 to 64 characters | no | Defaults to "Group N". |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.group",
  "id": "group-1",
  "drawingIds": [
    "support"
  ]
}
```

This example needs a drawing with id `support` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `INVALID_DRAWING_GROUP`.

## `drawing.updateGroup`

Rename a group or replace its members. Send at least one of name and drawingIds.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |
| `name` | string, 1 to 64 characters | no |  |
| `drawingIds` | array of (string, 1 to 128 characters), 1 to 100 items, unique | no |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.updateGroup",
  "id": "group-1",
  "name": "Levels"
}
```

This example needs a drawing group with id `group-1` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_GROUP_NOT_FOUND`.

## `drawing.ungroup`

Remove a group. Its drawings stay.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string, 1 to 128 characters | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "drawing.ungroup",
  "id": "group-1"
}
```

This example needs a drawing group with id `group-1` on the chart. On a chart without one it fails with `DRAWING_GROUP_NOT_FOUND`.

## `history.undo`

Undo the last content edit. Not allowed in a batch.

No properties besides `type`.

```json
{
  "type": "history.undo"
}
```

## `history.redo`

Redo. Not allowed in a batch.

No properties besides `type`.

```json
{
  "type": "history.redo"
}
```

## `feed.pause`

Pause or resume the data feed. Not allowed in a batch.

| Property | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paused` | boolean | yes |  |

```json
{
  "type": "feed.pause",
  "paused": true
}
```
